program.title: Tapestry parity, the gate sweep: every remaining assertion in the gate's tests counts waves, calls and recorded events, never wall-clock time or one random visitor (amendment 13, E34)
program.integrationGateCommand: rm -f coverage/ledger-integration.json; node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src --minWorkers=1 --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=coverage/ledger-integration.json; node scripts/remediation/score.mjs --from coverage/ledger-integration.json --check-ratchet && node --max-old-space-size=4096 node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --incremental false --composite false && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p src/sdk/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node scripts/build-sdk.mjs --check && node scripts/build-meridian.mjs --check

tickets.title: The gate counts, never times: the remaining sites (**amendment 13, E34, 2026-10-31**)

authority.locator: E34 · section 2 of amendment 13, "Done when" (the analysis _evidence/parity-step3/S55/analyst-intermittents/DESIGN.md §6, P109's review follow-ups R-P718 (2), W12.02's later legs R-P719; adopted R-P738; in force under the owner's direction, R-P545)
authority.requirement: every assertion in the gate's tests that bounds wall-clock time from above, or depends on one scheduling order or one random visitor, asserts counts, waves, recorded events, pinned subjects and per-action order instead; the time stays printed as evidence; each counted form still turns RED on the defect the timed form caught.

tickets.outcome: A whole-suite gate fails only on the product. On 30–31 October P61.LO3, P105.AL6, W12.02's later legs and P102 failed gates or builder runs on the shared box's load (a 250 ms margin, an absolute alarm time, elapsed-time waits), each failure costing a 1–2 hour re-run; P105 converted AL6 and P61.LO3 (R-P734). The same shape remains at the sites below.

criteria.observable: src/index.api-boundary.test.ts W12.02's later legs: :1447 compares the state after a refused wrong-URL send with the admitted state without the absolute time of an alarm the object re-arms itself (the alarm compared as armed, every other member exact); :1407's `learning: false` after held deliveries is asserted after the recorded deliveries, not after elapsed time; each still RED on its defect.
criteria.proof: The P110 acceptance command runs src/index.api-boundary.test.ts and unit:P110.GS1, and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: src/units/P102/LEDGER.unit.test.ts CR4's trip window is driven by a controlled clock or counted calls, never by the box's elapsed time; P109's meta-legs assert their `runs`; each still RED on its defect.
criteria.proof: The P110 acceptance command runs src/units/P102, src/units/P109 and unit:P110.GS2, and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: The named wall-clock bounds assert counts, waves or recorded events, with the time printed as evidence only: src/units/P94/LEDGER.unit.test.ts (NOISE_MS, ANSWER_B), src/units/P97/LEDGER.unit.test.ts (HOLD_MS, SAME_MS, WHOLE_MS, TRIP_MS), src/units/P62/LEDGER.unit.test.ts (ACK_DEADLINE_MS), src/content/consent.test.ts and src/index.api-boundary.test.ts (HELD_REFUSAL_BOUND_MS), src/index.api-boundary.test.ts (W12.02's sibling VALIDATION_DEADLINE_MS, W04.03's 4 s socket wait); each counted form RED on the defect its timed form caught, shown on a deterministic variant, never with load.
criteria.proof: The P110 acceptance command runs those files and unit:P110.GS3, and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: Every other `performance.now()` or `Date.now()` used in an assertion of the gate's tests (at least P56, P58, P59, P66, P70, P76, P96, P103, W38, src/reflex/contentCompose.test.ts, src/routes/realtime.sdkContract.test.ts) is either converted as GS3 or named in the specification as not an upper wall-clock bound, with the line.
criteria.proof: unit:P110.GS4 lists every such site with its disposition, and fails when a gate test file asserts an upper wall-clock bound that is not on the list; the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.
